title: The 9 best Notion alternatives in 2026
summary: These alternatives to Notion offer unique takes on the all-in-one workspace app, with that same blank slate feel you get from Notion.
body_markdown:

**Standout feature**

The gold standard of an all-in-one workspace

Free plan available; paid plans from $12/user/month
